quote: p36 note 6 'Claims Gross Reinsurers’ share Net £’000 ... At 1 January 2024 545,891 (79,540) 466,351 Expected cost of current year claims 445,078 (71,749) 373,329 Change in estimates of prior year provisions (67,573) 12,504 (55,069) Claims paid during year (229,088) 41,532 (187,556) Foreign exchange 8,166 (1,203) 6,963 At 31 December 2024 702,474 (98,456) 604,018'
arithmetic: The filing states the gross prior-year movement explicitly: 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' gross (67,573) GBP000 = -67.573m. Adopted -36.191m. Difference |-36.191 - (-67.573)| = 31.382m, above tolerance max(0.5, 0.05 x 36.191 = 1.810) = 1.810, so error (a). Same sign. Note roll-forward: 545,891 + 445,078 - 67,573 - 229,088 + 8,166 = 702,474. The adopted value is the p49 gross triangle summed over UW years to 2022 (-36,191). Adding the 2023 underwriting year's step (268,261 - 301,046 = -32,785) gives -68,976, within 1.4m of the note's line. The gap is therefore the development on the 2023 underwriting year, which the note's prior-year line includes and the report-year-minus-2 triangle route leaves out.
basis_check: Note 6 columns are Gross / Reinsurers’ share / Net; the gross value is (67,573) and the net value (55,069). The p49 triangle is 'Gross insurance contract outstanding claims provision as at 31 December 2024: ... Estimate of gross claims'. The p6 'Movement on underwriting years of account' table ('Net claims incurred 28,517 ...') and p7 'the back years, 2021 and prior, contributed £29.0m to the annual result' are net/result figures, not gross development.
page_binding_check: Syndicate 2791's own report ('Syndicate 2791 Annual Report and Accounts 2024', filed as HTML and read from the converted PDF). The note 6 closing gross 702,474 equals the p49 triangle total of gross claims liabilities. 'Claims outstanding includes £53.4m (2023: £35.0m) in respect of Syndicate 6103' refers to 6103's quota share held within 2791's gross provisions (funds withheld), not to a companion syndicate's separate figure.
reasoning: Unlike the 2022 and 2023 reports, this filing prints an explicit gross prior-year line in the claims note. Under the protocol that line is the filing's figure; the triangle recomputation is only the fallback when a triangle is all the filing gives. The pipeline overrode the models' reading (-67.573, which matches the note) with a report-year-minus-2 triangle sum. That sum is arithmetically right for the printed table but 31.4m short of the filing's stated prior-year movement. The filing's figures do not conflict: the note's line reconciles to the triangle summed over all underwriting years to 2023. The adopted figure excludes both 2023 and 2024, so this is not a scope-recent-years case, and the verdict rests on (a) magnitude.

The 2015 first-year estimate, 45% x 30,684 = 13,808 (p11 2015 account 13,694), matches the current-year line (13,535), not the prior line (11,732). The reinsurers' shares tie exactly: current 957 = 2015 account 957; prior (268) = (454) + 186 for the 2013* and 2014 accounts. The prior line 11,732 corresponds to the 2013* and 2014 accounts (13,501 - 1,268 = 12,233). The large current line fits the 2014 first year at 76% (about 17.2m implied from the rounded loss ratios and the 2014 account's 2015 claims), and 781 does not.
